hypothesis: When a person's preferences vary by situation, separate category effects can miss a shared latent preference. A Bayesian factorization machine estimates pair interactions and shrinks sparse levels using a shared prior for each field.
candidates: Fit myfm 0.4.0 probit classifiers of rank 8, with one-hot categorical fields, 160 Gibbs iterations, keep the last 96 parameter draws, seed 19731. The first uses de-duplicated raw fields. The second adds recurring profile and context keys and frequent profile by context-field levels when the profiles can be inferred from the fitting data. Each fit uses only 4061 fitting rows; two physical fits. A mixture of posterior draws is one model, not 96 independently trained configurations.
decision: Seal predictions from both variants before accessing the 808 nomination answers. Freeze one share of 0, .125, .25, .5 or 1 against the existing paired expert. Follow up on 817 and 807 separate training rows. Nonnegative on both plus .003 pooled is necessary for promotion to new ordinary-entry trials. These are exploratory development panels. No course validation or test, external labels or model API.
